title: Ukraine reportedly strikes Ust-Luga Baltic Sea port as drones attack regions across Russia
summary: Ukrainian drones struck the Ust-Luga Baltic Sea port in western Russia's Leningrad Oblast overnight on Nov. 11, monitoring channels reported.

title: US Senator tells incoming Congress not to give up on Ukraine, supply air defense
summary: "Attempts to pacify Putin are both fantasy and folly by an American president who seems forever enamored by this autocratic Russian leader who is endlessly playing President Trump for a fool," Sen. Richard Durbin said.
